drm-tests: walt: add blink_test for WALT Latency Timer This test alternates between black and white screen several times per second and prints out the timestamps of vsync events when color was flipped. This is used in combination with the WALT Latency Timer for measuring how quickly the screen can transition between white and black. WALT Latency Timer (https://github.com/google/walt/) is a physical device that times screen color changes using a light sensor. BUG=chromium:715356 TEST=Ran these commands: cros_workon_make drm-tests scp blink_test ... stop ui ./blink_test ./walt -t screen -n 10 Change-Id: I3f30c40e3bdde5987e7377df08dff48cf590615b Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/487284 Commit-Ready: Mark Koudritsky <kamrik@chromium.org> Tested-by: Mark Koudritsky <kamrik@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Mark Koudritsky <kamrik@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Gurchetan Singh <gurchetansingh@chromium.org>
